sections.title: From a dream *to reality*

image.alt: A candle and room spray on a glass stand

body: Iron Gate Candles is a family-owned and operated company specializing in 100% soy candles, all natural and handcrafted here in Aiken. Our goal is to offer a premium, high-quality and environmentally friendly product.

Every product is handcrafted in small batches with our customers in mind, from individual market sales to wholesale orders. From our wax, fragrance and essential oils to our containers and labels, we strive to use recycled or renewable resources.
